invalid_if: A governance right is drafted as a present obligation
The document states that a shareholders' agreement prevails over the Articles
name: Governance and Founder Terms
title: Governance and Founder Terms

legal_basis.note: Refusal of registration and appeal against refusal; transfer restrictions in a private company

authoring_note: Replaces the shareholders'-agreement clauses the old term sheet borrowed (board control, transfer restrictions, tag-along, drag-along), which were drafted as operative obligations on 'Shareholders' who were not parties, and which stated that the agreement prevails over the Articles. This provision states no precedence rule: it records the intention that the rights be put in the Articles.
d4_44: Rebuilt 9 Oct 2026. Non-binding provisions are drafted as proposals ('it is proposed that ... be'), never as obligations, so the wording agrees with the Status provision.
